name: slashtable
description: /table — A native desktop database client with a built-in MCP server for AI agents. PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and Neon. Local stdio only — there is no remote MCP URL.

transport.description: The /table MCP server runs locally as part of the desktop application. Install /table from https://www.slashtable.dev/download and enable the MCP server in Settings.
